summary: The writeback batch rows of ext2_hosttest.c, its --batch-only mode, with faults in rach2/sys/fs/ext2.c

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2" "$t/tests/host"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp -R tests/host/compat "$t/tests/host/compat"
cp tests/host/ext2_hosttest.c tests/host/ext2_batch_cases.h tests/host/ext2_batch_lifecycle.h "$t/tests/host/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
cd "$t"
for x in ext2_hosttest; do
    deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/$x.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' ')
    ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -DFIXDIR='"${WORK}/fixtures"' -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I ${TREE}/utils -I ${TREE}/krffs -I tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/$x tests/host/$x.c $deps
done

faults.name: per-call
faults.summary: a batch drained at every write

lines: FAIL: cross-call rewrite collection writes no blocks

faults.name: no-stage-flush
faults.summary: a drain without its cache flush

lines: FAIL: volatile media preserves pointer and size dependencies

faults.name: bytes
faults.summary: a batch that does not drain at its byte limit

lines: FAIL: the byte limit drains on its last block

faults.name: data
faults.summary: a batch that does not drain at its limit of data blocks

edits.find: if (wb->datas == EXT2_WB_DATA || wb->metas == EXT2_WB_META || wb->count == EXT2_WB_NODES) {

lines: FAIL: 256 distinct blocks drain without reaching the byte limit

faults.name: metadata
faults.summary: a batch that does not drain at its limit of metadata images

edits.find: if (wb->datas == EXT2_WB_DATA || wb->metas == EXT2_WB_META || wb->count == EXT2_WB_NODES) {

lines: FAIL: 32 metadata images drain before another admission

faults.name: inodes
faults.summary: a batch that does not drain at its limit of inodes

edits.find: if (wb->datas == EXT2_WB_DATA || wb->metas == EXT2_WB_META || wb->count == EXT2_WB_NODES) {

lines: FAIL: the sixteenth inode drains the batch

faults.name: release
faults.summary: a last close that does not drain the batch

lines: FAIL: the last shared close drains with an independent handle open

faults.name: sticky
faults.summary: an fsync that forgets an earlier write error

lines: FAIL: a successful retry preserves the earlier error

faults.name: handoff
faults.summary: an inode stored before the batch drains

lines: ext2_hosttest: panic: ext2: inode store before writeback drain

faults.name: abort
faults.summary: an abandoned unmount that sets the valid bit on disk

lines: FAIL: an abandoned unmount clears the valid bit on disk

faults.name: zero
faults.summary: a new data block filled with 0xAB, not zeroes

lines: FAIL: partial bytes and zeroing precede durable size or hole publication

faults.name: stage-lock
faults.summary: a drain that gives up the mount across its I/O

lines: FAIL: a draining generation retains mount ownership across I/O

faults.name: reserve-run
faults.summary: a mount that reserves a run longer than a reserve run

lines: FAIL: a read-write mount needs no run longer than a reserve run

faults.name: partial-batch
faults.summary: a mount that keeps a batch it has freed
